key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inference, completed justification, faith, the pinned indicative “we have,” peace, mediation, and full title.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, since we have been set right through trust, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, since we have been declared righteous by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, having been set right through trust, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hope's outcome, shame, divine love, pouring image, hearts, Spirit, and gift.
key_decisions.before: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who has been given to us.
key_decisions.after: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And hope does not put us to shame, because the love of God has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit that has been given to us.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps greater-to-lesser inference, present justification, blood, future salvation, mediation, and wrath.
key_decisions.before: Much more then, now that we have been set right by his blood, we will be saved through him from wrath.
key_decisions.after: How much more, then, since we have now been declared righteous by his blood, will we be saved through him from wrath.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Much more surely then, having now been set right by his blood, will we be saved through him from wrath.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves enemy status, reconciliation, God, Son's death, a-fortiori logic, and living salvation.
key_decisions.before: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, now that we are reconciled, will we be saved by his life.
key_decisions.after: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, will we be saved by his life.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For if while we were enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of the Son, much more surely, having been reconciled, will we be saved by his life.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves comparison's open syntax, one man, sin's entrance, death, universal spread, and reads eph' hō causally while noting the alternative.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one human being, and death through sin, so death spread to all people because all sinned—
key_decisions.after: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so death spread to all people, because all sinned—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one human being, and death through sin, and so death spread to all, because all sinned—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves royal metaphor, exact span, distinct sin, Adam, transgression, type, and coming figure.
key_decisions.before: Yet death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those who did not sin in the likeness of Adam’s transgression. Adam is a pattern of the one who was to come.
key_decisions.after: Nevertheless, death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those who did not sin in the likeness of Adam's transgression. Adam is a pattern of the one to come.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Yet death exercised dominion from Adam to Moses, even over those whose sin was not like the transgression of Adam, who is a type of the one who was to come.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps contrast, gift/trespass, one/many structure, death, greater grace, full name, and abundance.
key_decisions.before: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died through the trespass of one person, how much more did God’s grace and the gift in the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!
key_decisions.after: But the gracious gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died through one man's trespass, how much more did God's grace and the gift in the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died through the trespass of the one, much more surely have the grace of God and the gift in the grace of the one human being, Jesus Christ, overflowed for the many.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves second contrast, one offense/many offenses, judgment, condemnation, gift, and justifying verdict.
key_decisions.before: And the gift is not like what came through the one person who sinned. Judgment from one trespass led to condemnation, but the gift after many trespasses led to setting right.
key_decisions.after: Nor is the gift like the result of the one man's sin. The judgment from one trespass led to condemnation, but the gracious gift from many trespasses led to a verdict of righteousness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the gift is not like the effect of the one person’s sin. For the judgment following one trespass led to condemnation, but the gift following many trespasses leads to being set right.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves balanced comparison, single acts, universal scope, condemnation, justification, and life.
key_decisions.before: Therefore, just as one trespass led to condemnation for all people, so one righteous act leads to setting right and life for all people.
key_decisions.after: So then, just as one trespass led to condemnation for all people, so also one righteous act led to justification and life for all people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore, just as through one trespass came condemnation for all human beings, so also through one righteous act came setting right that leads to life for all human beings.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps one/many parallel, disobedience/obedience, constituted status, and future righteousness.
key_decisions.before: For just as through the disobedience of one human being the many were made sinners, so through the obedience of the one the many will be made righteous.
key_decisions.after: For just as through the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, so also through the one man's obedience the many will be made righteous.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For just as through the disobedience of the one human being the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one the many will be made righteous.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Law's entry, purpose/effect, increase, contrast, and intensified superabundance.
key_decisions.before: The Law came in so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace overflowed all the more,
key_decisions.after: Now the Law came in alongside so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace overflowed all the more,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now the law came in so that the trespass might increase; but where sin increased, grace overflowed all the more,
